fact: On 28 November 2025 the HAC president announced a formal ban on all media, including their social-media channels, broadcasting AI-generated speech or images during the 28 December presidential campaign, to prevent manipulation; no sanctions schedule is stated.

fact: Guinea's ANSSI said on 12 September 2025 that manipulating and illicitly circulating AI-generated images or videos of public figures is punished under Guinean law, with civil and criminal liability including content removal and compensation, and 5 to 10 years' imprisonment with heavy fines.
The ministry's secretary-general says Guinea has no legislative or regulatory framework on AI and has adopted no AI-specific law.
